subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should maintainers require live Codex app-server proof for this PR before merge, or explicitly accept the source-contract plus focused-test evidence as sufficient?
rationale: The code direction is supported by source inspection, but the reported live producer path is not proven because current OpenClaw projects Codex `commandExecution` items to `bash`.

options.title: Require live proof after refresh
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase and add redacted live Codex app-server terminal output, logs, or a recording covering both suppressed read-only failure and visible mutating failure behavior.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly decide that upstream Codex source plus focused OpenClaw tests are enough despite no live app-server turn.

options.title: Pause or close if proof never appears
options.body: If no producer-path evidence is feasible, pause this PR and keep the canonical issue open for a replacement fix with stronger proof.

recommendation.title: Require live proof after refresh
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to rebase and add redacted live Codex app-server terminal output, logs, or a recording covering both suppressed read-only failure and visible mutating failure behavior.
